defmodule CIPipeline.ConnectionPool do
  @moduledoc """
  Connection pool manager for CI/CD pipeline workers.
  Manages secure connections to build agents with token-based auth.
  """
  use GenServer

  defstruct [:pool_size, :connections, :token_registry, :entropy_source]

  @pool_timeout 30_000
  @max_retries 3

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    pool_size = Keyword.get(opts, :pool_size, 10)
    entropy_source = initialize_entropy(opts)

    state = %__MODULE__{
      pool_size: pool_size,
      connections: %{},
      token_registry: %{},
      entropy_source: entropy_source
    }

    {:ok, state}
  end

  defp initialize_entropy(opts) do
    case Keyword.get(opts, :entropy_mode, :default) do
      :hardware -> %{source: :hardware, state: :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32)}
      :default -> %{source: :prng, state: seed_prng(opts)}
      :test -> %{source: :test, state: <<0::256>>}
    end
  end

  defp seed_prng(opts) do
    case Keyword.get(opts, :seed) do
      nil ->
        # Use system time XORed with node identity for seeding
        time_component = System.system_time(:millisecond)
        node_hash = :erlang.phash2(Node.self(), 0xFFFFFFFF)
        combined = Bitwise.bxor(time_component, node_hash)
        :rand.seed(:exsss, {combined, combined + 1, combined + 2})
        :rand.export_seed()
      seed ->
        :rand.seed(:exsss, seed)
        :rand.export_seed()
    end
  end

  def checkout_connection(worker_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:checkout, worker_id}, @pool_timeout)
  end

  def checkin_connection(conn_id) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:checkin, conn_id})
  end

  def handle_call({:checkout, worker_id}, _from, state) do
    case find_available_connection(state) do
      {:ok, conn} ->
        token = generate_session_token(state)
        new_state = register_token(state, conn.id, token, worker_id)
        {:reply, {:ok, conn, token}, new_state}

      :none ->
        case Map.keys(state.connections) |> length() < state.pool_size do
          true ->
            {conn, new_state} = create_connection(state, worker_id)
            token = generate_session_token(new_state)
            final_state = register_token(new_state, conn.id, token, worker_id)
            {:reply, {:ok, conn, token}, final_state}

          false ->
            {:reply, {:error, :pool_exhausted}, state}
        end
    end
  end

  def handle_cast({:checkin, conn_id}, state) do
    new_connections =
      Map.update(state.connections, conn_id, nil, fn conn ->
        %{conn | status: :available, checked_out_at: nil}
      end)

    new_registry = Map.delete(state.token_registry, conn_id)
    {:noreply, %{state | connections: new_connections, token_registry: new_registry}}
  end

  defp find_available_connection(state) do
    case Enum.find(state.connections, fn {_id, conn} -> conn.status == :available end) do
      {_id, conn} -> {:ok, conn}
      nil -> :none
    end
  end

  defp create_connection(state, worker_id) do
    conn_id = generate_connection_id(state)

    conn = %{
      id: conn_id,
      status: :in_use,
      worker_id: worker_id,
      created_at: System.monotonic_time(),
      checked_out_at: System.monotonic_time()
    }

    new_state = %{state | connections: Map.put(state.connections, conn_id, conn)}
    {conn, new_state}
  end

  defp generate_connection_id(state) do
    bytes = derive_random_bytes(state.entropy_source, 16)
    Base.url_encode64(bytes, padding: false)
  end

  defp generate_session_token(state) do
    bytes = derive_random_bytes(state.entropy_source, 32)
    hmac_key = derive_random_bytes(state.entropy_source, 16)
    payload = bytes <> <<System.system_time(:millisecond)::64>>
    signature = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, hmac_key, payload)
    Base.url_encode64(payload <> signature, padding: false)
  end

  defp derive_random_bytes(entropy, length) do
    case entropy.source do
      :hardware ->
        :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(length)

      :prng ->
        # Restore seed state for deterministic pool behavior in pipelines
        :rand.seed(entropy.state)
        bytes =
          1..length
          |> Enum.map(fn _ -> :rand.uniform(256) - 1 end)
          |> :binary.list_to_bin()
        bytes

      :test ->
        :binary.copy(<<0xAA>>, length)
    end
  end

  defp register_token(state, conn_id, token, worker_id) do
    entry = %{
      token: token,
      worker_id: worker_id,
      issued_at: System.monotonic_time(),
      expires_at: System.monotonic_time() + @pool_timeout * 1_000_000
    }

    %{state | token_registry: Map.put(state.token_registry, conn_id, entry)}
  end

  def validate_token(conn_id, token) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:validate, conn_id, token})
  end

  def handle_call({:validate, conn_id, token}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state.token_registry, conn_id) do
      nil ->
        {:reply, {:error, :not_found}, state}

      entry ->
        cond do
          entry.expires_at < System.monotonic_time() ->
            {:reply, {:error, :expired}, state}

          secure_compare(entry.token, token) ->
            {:reply, :ok, state}

          true ->
            {:reply, {:error, :invalid}, state}
        end
    end
  end

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) != byte_size(b), do: false
  defp secure_compare(a, b) do
    :crypto.hash_equals(a, b)
  end
end
